scope: Independent pre-fit audit of root runner; owned estimator implementation acknowledged. No scientific input panels fitted during this review.

validation.unit_tests: 9 tests passed independently in current scrna_r CPU environment, BLAS threads=1
additional_fixtures: k=0 fit_assay returns empty arrays and eligible mask
abstained source result bypasses fingerprints without dereferencing None
empty/absent source pairs yield no forced matches
fixed discrete integer fixture fit_arm exports strict JSON and NPZ readable with allow_pickle=False, no object arrays

not_run: No source or frozen protocol modified
findings: Raw counts, positive outside-panel depths and unique IDs validated; original source bytes checked against frozen manifest.
Source fitting/rank uses deterministic 75% training split; remaining 25% supplies fixed-direction fingerprints. Public test/evaluator reads are absent from this executable.
Outside-panel proxy exposure is derived from original counts before any permutation and normalized on source-fit rows only.
Column controls shuffle integer values separately inside source-fit and calibration partitions and exposure strata.
Both estimators share rank, source seeds and bootstrap resampling seeds; bootstrap direction alignment is within-assay only.
Source eligibility requires finite calibration moments/CF, at least26 valid bootstraps, loading stability, tensor fit and no rank-cap binding.
Pair matching requires finite precision band, unique sign and mutual unique source; all-assay candidates require sign-consistent cliques.
Native graph stage is called only on >=2 all-assay candidates and explicitly labeled exploratory.
k=0 and estimator abstention paths preserve artifacts without None/object-array failures.
scope_limits: Permutation rank is a declared approximate marginal-preserving screen, not a general false-discovery guarantee.
Finite fingerprint agreement is practical equivalence at specified moments/frequencies, not identification of an entire source law.
Observed outside-panel depth is a proxy; conditional-Poisson assumptions and independent affine sources remain model assumptions.
Zero candidate-shared covariance is a prediction/abstention baseline, not evidence that actual cross-assay covariance is zero.
Uncorrected and corrected low-rank covariance predictions use their declared noise-diagonal conventions; k=0 or constant-feature prediction denominators must remain guarded in the separate evaluator.
